name: HyperASHS-PMC-T1
shortdesc: MTL subfield and hippocampus segmentation in ~1mm T1-MRI using HyperASHS with PMC 3T unified atlas
longdesc: Automatic segmentation of MTL subregions and hippocampal subfields in high-resolution T2-weighted 3 Tesla MRI scans, using the 2026 unified atlas from the Penn Memory Center. The  (Xie et al., 2019) T1-ASHS atlas has been extended to incorporate anterior MTL cortex and amygdala (Sadeghpour et al., 2025) and is consistent with the T2/T1 HyperASHS-PMC atlas.

tags.name: T1-MRI
tags.hint: Roughtly isotropic (e.g., 1x1x1mm^3) T1-weighted MRI scan of the whole brain.
